seo.title: Flatten PDF — Free & Secure | JDpdf
seo.description: Merge form fields and annotations permanently into the page content of a PDF. Free, fast, and private — no installation required.

subtitle: Merge form fields and annotations permanently into the page content.

howItWorks.title: How to flatten a PDF
steps: Upload the PDF file you want to flatten.
Click Flatten to merge its fields and annotations into the page.

items.q: What does flattening a PDF do?
items.a: It converts interactive form fields, comments, and other annotations into permanent page content, so they display the same everywhere but can no longer be edited or filled in.
Yes, flattening a PDF is free within the daily usage limits shown above.

items.q: Will my file be kept private?
items.a: Yes. Files are processed securely and automatically deleted after a short retention period.
